modules.title: Dashboard
modules.purpose: Start from live inbound, storage, outbound, capacity, and exception signals.
normal: Select active warehouse and Floor, Dock, or Office view
Read open work and exceptions
Open the source module for live detail
modules.handoff: Manager sets priority; operator opens the assigned queue.
modules.avoid: Do not use an aggregate tile as evidence for a pallet decision.

modules.title: Warehouses
modules.purpose: Define the top-level physical facilities used by all warehouse activity.
normal: Create one stable unique facility code
Maintain identity, location context, status, and cool capability
Confirm the facility exists physically as configured
modules.handoff: Build zones and locations before releasing work.
modules.avoid: Do not duplicate codes or disable a facility with dependent work.

modules.title: Clients
modules.purpose: Identify who owns 3PL stock and which commercial handling rules apply.
normal: Maintain short stable client codes
Set ownership, expiry, and mixed-stock controls
Deactivate rather than delete historical context
modules.handoff: Products and Receiving select the verified owner.
modules.avoid: Never receive stock under a guessed client.

modules.title: Zones
modules.purpose: Group space by workflow purpose and temperature class.
normal: Separate Receiving, Picking, Dispatch, Quarantine, Bulk, Cool/Frozen uses
Set temperature and no-normal-stock flags
Verify zone purpose against the floor
modules.handoff: Generate exact bin locations and labels.
modules.avoid: Do not mix staging, dispatch, and quarantine rules for convenience.

modules.title: Bin Locations
modules.purpose: Define exact cells used for storage, picks, moves, counts, and capacity.
normal: Maintain aisle, bay, level, position/depth, sequence, and capacity
Print exact-cell and bay labels
Keep active status and physical rack aligned
modules.handoff: Operators consume the labels in execution modules.
modules.avoid: Never change a code without replacing the floor label.

modules.title: Products
modules.purpose: Define SKU identity, owner, rotation, tracking, temperature, and handling.
normal: Create/import verified SKU, name, owner, and barcode
Set FIFO/FEFO, lot/expiry, and temperature controls
Hide discontinued items; preserve history
modules.handoff: Create the correct Packaging Profile before Receiving.
modules.avoid: No guessed SKUs, duplicate barcodes, or unknown rotation values.

modules.title: Packaging Profiles
modules.purpose: Connect each/case/pallet units and barcodes to physical receiving quantities.
normal: Configure pack sizes, dimensions, weights, and barcodes
Keep one appropriate default profile
Verify values against the physical pack
modules.handoff: Receiving interprets scans and quantities from the profile.
modules.avoid: Multiple defaults or incorrect units-per-package create downstream defects.

modules.title: Receiving
modules.purpose: Create receipt, pallet identity, traceability, labels, and Put-Away work.
normal: Warehouse/container/PO → product scan + commit
Physical total → qty/pallet → pallets → expiry/lot
Verify once → receive → print labels → release Put-Away
modules.handoff: Each labeled pallet has a Put-Away task or identifiable Saved Draft.
modules.avoid: Do not guess SKU/count, skip the commit arrow, or post offline.

modules.title: Put-Away
modules.purpose: Store one identified pallet in one exact eligible cell and make it available.
normal: Select task and scan pallet
Scan exact location or select exact bay cell
Verify safety/capacity/temperature → place → confirm once
modules.handoff: Task clears and Inventory Search shows the stored location.
modules.avoid: A bay code is not final; never force a blocked or stale destination.

modules.title: Inventory Search
modules.purpose: Provide the live pallet truth: quantity, status, owner, lot, location, and history.
normal: Search pallet, SKU, lot, warehouse, zone, or location
Open detail and movement history
Compare the record with the physical floor
modules.handoff: Verified facts justify the next pick, move, transfer, status, or count action.
modules.avoid: Do not act from memory, paper, dashboard totals, or hidden filters.

modules.title: Pick Lists
modules.purpose: Plan, release, assign, and execute outbound whole-pallet work.
normal: Manager verifies demand, stock, staging, owner, and due time
Release executable whole-pallet tasks
Operator scans assigned location + pallet → confirms → stages
modules.handoff: Completed pallets move to the directed outbound lane.
modules.avoid: No short release, normal pallet split, or forced quantity mismatch.

modules.title: Transfers
modules.purpose: Move pallet identity across warehouse boundaries with signed handoffs.
normal: Create and stage the verified pallet/route
Driver signs after physical departure
Destination receives and immediately triggers Put-Away
modules.handoff: Destination Receiving and Put-Away finish the journey.
modules.avoid: Do not sign before departure or strand received stock in a lane.

modules.title: Location Moves
modules.purpose: Relocate a pallet inside the same warehouse with full movement history.
normal: Scan pallet and verify live state
Scan/type/Browse bays; select exact eligible cell
Move physically → confirm once → verify Inventory Search
modules.handoff: Inventory now points to the exact destination.
modules.avoid: Different warehouse means Transfer, not Location Move.

modules.title: Cycle Counts
modules.purpose: Run blind physical counts and controlled variance review.
normal: Manager scopes and assigns CCT work
Operator verifies location and submits the true physical count online
Supervisor reviews threshold variance, notes, and exceptions
modules.handoff: Approved corrections update stock and produce root-cause work.
modules.avoid: Do not count the expected value or approve stale post-reconnect state.

modules.title: Statuses
modules.purpose: Keep Available, Hold, Quarantine, Damaged, and Missing stock visible and controlled.
normal: Verify pallet and physical condition
Choose only the justified status and enter a reason
Add System Log ownership when follow-up is required
modules.handoff: Status controls availability and the next authorized action.
modules.avoid: Do not mark Damaged/Missing on assumption or release without verification.

modules.title: Reports
modules.purpose: Show management snapshots for stock, occupancy, expiry, movement, and variance.
normal: Review the relevant current report
Identify the material trend or bottleneck
Drill into the operational module or Inventory Search
modules.handoff: Assign an action owner and verify later performance.
modules.avoid: Reports do not replace live transactional detail.

modules.title: Users & Roles
modules.purpose: Create, approve, authorize, badge/PIN-enable, disable, and audit access.
normal: Create/approve the user
Assign least privilege and issue approved credentials
Test access; hide role or disable profile non-destructively
modules.handoff: Reassign open work before access changes.
modules.avoid: No shared credentials, excessive roles, deletion, or mid-task disablement.

modules.title: System Log
modules.purpose: Track operational issues, RF alerts, support notes, ownership, and resolution.
normal: Review evidence and severity
Assign the correct owner and investigate underlying records
Resolve only after the physical/system condition is corrected
modules.handoff: Quality, client, IT, or warehouse follow-up reaches accountable closure.
modules.avoid: A log note does not replace the required inventory/status transaction.

modules.title: Email Log
modules.purpose: Show outbound message attempts, recipients, templates, status, and errors.
normal: Find the user/message attempt
Read recipient, template, delivery state, and error
Correct the cause; retry or escalate provider/DNS/suppression
modules.handoff: Confirm delivery before telling the user it succeeded.
modules.avoid: Do not retry repeatedly without reading the failure.

modules.title: Settings
modules.purpose: Group Warehouse Structure, Users & Roles, release guidance, setup, and controlled administration.
normal: Open the relevant tab only
Make the narrow intended configuration change
Verify downstream labels, access, and operational behavior
modules.handoff: Return to the affected module and prove normal work still works.
modules.avoid: No reset without a rebuild plan or structure change without labels.

modules.title: Help Center
modules.purpose: Provide current contextual and searchable guidance across the system.
normal: Open contextual Help from the current module
Review key actions, mistakes, and linked articles
Search by workflow, module, error, or operational term
modules.handoff: Return only when the normal next action is clear; escalate dead ends.
modules.avoid: Do not rely on an outdated printout or one exact search phrase.

modules.title: Setup Wizard
modules.purpose: Create or extend facilities, zones, and generated bin locations from a reviewed design.
normal: Define facilities → zones → location rules
Review totals and codes before creation
Create → print/install labels → verify Warehouse Structure
modules.handoff: Prepare products/packaging, then release operational work.
modules.avoid: It is not a routine correction tool after go-live; never run without the physical plan.
